actual.title: GDP Growth Comparison: Baseline vs. Scenario

actual.text: The reduction in investment/GDP ratio from 31% to 24% results in a sustained decline in GDP growth rates.
By 2035, the cumulative impact is significant. The GDP index under the scenario reaches 375.6 compared to 413.9 in the baseline,
Lower investment leads to slower capital accumulation, which compounds over time.
